plugins.sourceCode: using UnityEngine; public class Debuger : MonoBehaviour, IValvyPlugin { public string PluginName => "Debuger"; public string Desc => "it prints to the console when somone join or left ect..."; public void OnPluginInitialize() { Debug.Log($"{PluginName} initialized!"); Debug.Log($"{Desc} initialized!"); } public void OnPlayerJoined(int clientId) { Debug.Log($"Player #{clientId} joined."); } public void OnPlayerLeft(int clientId) { Debug.Log($"Player #{clientId} left."); } public void OnRoomCreated(string roomId) { Debug.Log($"Room {roomId} created!"); } public void OnNetworkUpdate() { } public void OnCustomPacketReceived(string packetType, string data, int senderId) { Debug.Log($"Packet [{packetType}] received from {senderId}: {data}"); } }
